In general a 2/10 (The later areas really ruined this game) -- Full review with tears and everything :) -- Beat the game now... took me around 12 attempts 4 of the 12 attempts were fun afterwards it became nonsensical as i consistently got to later levels. Here's why. Rose is a good free to play game and its definitively worth the shot HOWEVER this game is extremely unfair not even darksouls has this amount of cheese. Certain traits make you lose (And at one point i was forced to pick said trait that makes me lose however i had enough points to cancel it out otherwise i WOULD have instantly lost the game like ???) Half of the time you don't know what you are doing. Projectiles are flying past you and you are just shooting. Even in ultrakill i understood what i was doing. Now given the design of rose its not a bad thing but why i made it a negative is that the way its done is just not fun. Graphics are great i like em they aren't 4k ultrahd nonsense and it doesn't have to be. its like ultrakill in terms of graphic quality. Also i first thought the epilepsy danger wasn't that bad but then at the end it blasted me with as much epilepsy triggers as possible thanks? I guess? Now i will say about every area one by one. Cause i want you to be mentally prepared if you do play 1st area is PEAK it couldn't have been better 1st area boss is mid (Projectile spam GO!!!!) 2nd area is ok.... its map design is ass enemies are still original which is more then some other paid roguelites could say 2nd area boss is SLOP HOOOLY SLOP. If you are playing this set your mind to get instantly killed no buts no if's you are DEAD no avoiding DEATH instantly. 3rd area its bad. first map i got was interesting until i discovered its a hide and seek for hidden enemies that distort your view when you get hit once. 3rd boss... mid. not bad but not good it feels like the titan boss you find in ultrakill which you kill in about a few seconds but here its 3 - 5 minutes. which is eh... 4th area... uh? I think there was meant to be more content but i got another hide and seek which felt like filler and then i was forced to take a item that would instantly lose the game... So i had to use points to cancel it out like wtf? 4th area boss literally vomiting. Not cause its super bad... Well its bad but it was SO SO confusing i actually got motion sickness projectiles here projectiles there spawns and then suddenly my screens blood red like i am playing cruelty squad wanna be.. Then afterwards i killed it (extremely easy btw just pick the specific weapon that's good and you win won't spoil which tho) I got hit with as much epilepsy triggers as possible. I DO NOT KNOW WHAT the devs were thinking but holy why so many flashing imagery? Also the blood splatters on the screen are so bad you sometimes couldn't see i eventually got used to not being able to see the game and as such just started remembering which direction i was walking and what was in front of me but like... That's not something you should expect from players.

It's interesting, with different weapons and lots of upgrades to choose. The premise of losing body parts after each room brings more variability to the runs. I think just because of this and the fact that is free, it's worth checking out. Sadly, it has some big problems, being one of them the hitboxes of the enemy attacks, extremely unpredictable and almost unfair (especially with the bosses), making you die instantly. It's also very glutted with flashes and visual effects, and many enemies are not fun to fight. It's good, still worth playing even with the inconveniences. Esp: Es interesante, con diferentes armas y un montón de mejoras para elegir. La premisa de perder partes del cuerpo después de cada habitación aporta más variabilidad a las partidas. Creo que sólo por esto y el hecho de que es gratis, vale la pena echarle un vistazo. Lamentablemente, tiene algunos grandes problemas, siendo uno de ellos los hitboxes de los ataques enemigos, extremadamente impredecibles y casi injustos (especialmente con los jefes), haciéndote morir instantáneamente. También está muy saturado de flashes y efectos visuales, y muchos enemigos no son divertidos de combatir. Es bueno, merece la pena jugarlo incluso con las molestias.

I wish I had something better to say about this game, but it just sucks. The performance is very poor, getting frequent frame drops even on the lowest possible settings to the point it affects playability. Common enemy types are obnoxious, frequently spamming grab attacks to the point that you're just spamming the slide key all the time. The instructions are very, very, very unclear, and the upgrades aren't particularly satisfying, the only permanent upgrades being very minor weapon upgrades. I liked the dev's other work and was looking forward to this one, sadly I found myself wishing I was playing absolutely anything else while I was playing this.

"ROSE" is an overambitious yet incredibly shallow contentless, pointless FPS arena shooter where you shoot stuff because, well, there's actually no reason to want to. The cel shaded low poly "art" looks hideous, too. In some ways this could be described as the opposite of a game. What do you do in the game? Shoot stuff endlessly and pointlessly in this procgen nightmare wading pool. The graphics here are particularly awful, so bad that it actually stands out as one of the worst looking games on Steam. Quite an accomplishment. It's a big contributor to the failure of the game to attract gamers despite having no up-front cost. Gaming is a primarily visual medium, and if developers want to succeed, they must understand that it's not an area for compromise. The developer chose not to do the job of a real game developer and create meaningful bespoke levels, narrative based gameplay progression and so on. Instead, they decided that "Procgen IS content!" and lazily tried to use procgen algorithms to create infinite, samey, repetitive, soulless levels, because that's a lot less work. As a result of this poor decision, the game gets tired and repetitive almost immediately. Developers must learn that procgen is a terrible substitute for creating real content. It should not be used as "ez-mode" for content creation, as the developer tried to do here. This is only free in a rudimentary sense... the developer has their hand out for a $8 USD "donation" for this as you're expected to buy some extra DLC from Steam... digital panhandling. Like the homeless guys who splash dirty water on your windscreen at the traffic lights. No thanks. Yeah, eight bucks! That's some serious, hard core begging. I'm kinda surprised they didn't just for $500 or something. I mean if you're going to fantasize about people giving you money, why not shoot the moon? Even though this is "free", it failed to appeal to the 120 million+ gamers on Steam. SteamDB showed the game peaked at just a dozen or so concurrent players, and now there's basically nobody playing it. Even though it's free. This is a dismal public reception, but it's easy to see why gamers rejected it. Bearing in mind that free games don't add +1 to your game collector count, should you bother adding this to your library and downloading it? Nope. This isn't worth downloading. While this didn't cost me any money up front, I still feel ripped off.

免费 有成就 没中文 《罗斯》（ROSE） 《罗斯》是一款融合类 Rogue 元素的暴力竞技场射击游戏。你可以通过牺牲身体部位，或撤销已有的牺牲来获得增益与新能力，打造专属战斗流派。解锁新武器，并通过强力升级强化它们；在随机生成的竞技场中推进，击败疯狂的敌人与巨型首领，揭开背后的黑暗故事。为了拯救失踪的女儿罗斯（Rose），你愿意付出怎样的牺牲？ 以血肉为祭，换取力量 每通关一个竞技场，你都能从多个牺牲选项中进行选择。牺牲会增加游戏的复杂度与难度，但每牺牲一个身体部位，都会为游戏新增机制，带来显著的玩法改变。 每次牺牲都会提升你的压力值 —— 当压力值累积到一定程度，你可以撤销某项牺牲，转而获得一种新能力。 千变万化的竞技场 竞技场会从数十种预设布局中随机选取，陷阱、敌人及其他物体则通过程序随机生成。每个竞技场都可能刷新多波敌人。 部分竞技场中，你可以通过战斗争夺额外奖励 —— 这类场景中的敌人会带有特殊规则，迫使你制定策略、改变玩法风格，才能完成规则目标。 并非所有竞技场都完全相同：有些可能提供局内专属升级，有些则会以迷你首领的形式，为你带来额外挑战。 武器与能力 每款武器都能带来独特的玩法体验，部分武器甚至能改变地图本身。 武器种类丰富多样：从基础左轮手枪，到需以自身血液为弹药、每射偏一次就会对你造成惩罚的 “疯狂枪械”，应有尽有。 解锁新武器后，每次死亡都能对其进行升级 —— 随后即可再度投入战斗！ 敌人与首领 敌人会以 “波次” 形式刷新。当你清空特定波次的敌人后，献祭祭坛将解锁，你也将前往新的竞技场。部分竞技场不会刷新普通敌人，而是直接出现首领。 故事背景 《罗斯》讲述了一个关于生命、死亡与希望的故事。 随着你在竞技场中推进、触发特殊遭遇、击败首领，甚至在死亡时，都将逐步揭开更多故事细节。 游戏特色（Features） 以血肉牺牲换取游戏进程推进 撤销牺牲以获取增益效果 解锁并升级独特武器 屠戮一波又一波疯狂敌人 击败巨型首领 在随机生成的竞技场中推进，揭开黑暗故事 躲避陷阱及其他程序随机生成的障碍物

This game confuses me. It has a decent story, it's not RDR2 but it gives meaning to the game loop and has some actual substance in terms of theme. The visual design is honestly outstanding for a free game by a solo dev. The core mechanics are satisfying and the game is overall enjoyable. The thing is, the game design is pretty bad. First there's the performance issues. There are so settings to disable but the game ♥♥♥♥♥ itself during pretty much every bossfight. Then there's the roguelike design; there isn't much variety in rooms from run to run but there are more bosses than there are bossfights per run. Putting variation into the bosses but not the rooms seemed weird to me. The biggest thing is the weapons. The weapons are all enjoyable to use and all quite powerful and then there's one which allows you to kill every boss in roughly 5 seconds. The game allows you to stack up huge damage multipliers using gun abilities which is nice because it forces you to use strategy but some of the abilities are just stupid broken. On the other side there's the blood daggers which while not terrible, are so much more annoying to use than the guns so I would never choose it during a run. There's also the totems which are very unbalanced. The healing totem is so much stronger than the others because it's the only defensive one and the weapons do enough damage as is. There's a few other details but the game design is just overall very weird and feels not very thought through. If this was a $10 game then those issues would make this a not recommend, but this game is free so I can easily overlook them. It's still a fun game, I just think there are quite a few weird quirks with it.
